question: What has concentrating been like over the last few days?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “It’s been harder to hold on to a thought when I’m tired. Before lunch I usually do better. Writing things down helps—my flatmate keeps a pencil by the shopping list. But in a conversation you can’t always stop and write… what was I going to say? That’s the frustrating bit, losing the point.”
